Name: Young Wizard Portraits (Magnus Rasmodius)
Author: amycocopops
Description:
[b]Credit to[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister] Poltergeister[/url][/b] who created the original art for Isaac (whose character I used as a base)
^Since my adaptation so closely resembles her original work, all permissions and restrictions must align with hers; please check her profile before using these portraits outside their intended uses.

How to install:
(1) Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture [/url]installed.
(2) Install like you would any other portrait that uses Portraiture. Here is the step-by-step:
[list]
[*]Create a folder in Mods/Portraiture/Portraits and name it however you like (for example "CustomPortraits"). 
[*]Download the file, extract anywhere, and copy the .png file into the Portraiture subfolder you created. Example: Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/CustomPortraits.
[/list](3) Open the game, go speak to the Wizard, and press the "P" key to toggle the set of portraits until you see the portrait you want.
